content: [{"content": "Steam turbines were not ideally suited to the railroad environment and failed to replace classic reciprocating steam units in the way modern diesel and electric traction has done.", "importance": 0.85, "category": "factual_context"}, {"content": "Direct-drive locomotives found success in long haul freight operations in Sweden and express passenger work in Britain but were not repeated elsewhere.", "importance": 0.75, "category": "factual_context"}, {"content": "In the U.S.A., experimental advanced designs with electric transmission were built but not reproduced.", "importance": 0.6, "category": "factual_context"}, {"content": "Citizens and corporations have standing to bring claims against EU institutions and member states for treaty violations when treaties are interpreted as creating rights and obligations.", "importance": 0.9, "category": "legal_precedent"}, {"content": "Member states and the European Commission have general legal right or 'standing' (locus standi) to bring claims against EU institutions and other member states for breach of treaties.", "importance": 0.85, "category": "legal_precedent"}, {"content": "Under Directives, citizens and corporations may not have standing to bring claims unless the directives are interpreted as creating rights and obligations.", "importance": 0.7, "category": "legal_precedent"}]
